usage: The word refers to a specific role or job title someone holds within an organization.
It can be used in both formal and informal contexts when discussing employment or organizational hierarchy.
It is often combined with verbs related to applying for, holding, or changing a job.
This phrase helps differentiate one’s specific responsibilities and rank in the workplace.
It may appear in discussions about promotions, job descriptions, and company structures.
